# Bounded OSM routing fixture

Public OpenStreetMap extract, requested bbox [13.404,52.519,13.406,52.521], about 0.03016 km2. Retrieved once from the existing Overpass API for bounded offline route verification. 76,275 bytes, 337 elements. Source data timestamp is retained in the JSON.

Attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors. Database license: ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright . This is public road topology, not a user track or GPS recording. Tests compile motorcar and motorcycle graphs separately from the retained source tags; neither profile is relabelled from another graph.
